description: Copy a file or a whole folder. Parent folders of to are created; links are copied as links. Nothing is copied if to already exists (FileBad). Returns JSON {from, to, counter_files}. Errors: PathBad (to is inside from), FileMissing, FileBad, CopyFailed. Details: knowledge_read aos/tools/copy.json.

from.description: source path, relative to your workspace, or absolute

to.description: full destination path (not the folder to copy into)
